remarks: A beautiful modern interpretation of a traditional colonial, this 3,482 SF residence was built by award winning Hemingway Construction and is ideally located near the train, town, beaches and Great Island all short walk away. The neighborhood is zoned for Blue Ribbon award-winning Hindley Elementary School, where everyone can enjoy biking and walking to school together. The first floor features classic living spaces enhanced with custom built-ins, wet bar, wine refrigerator, butler's pantry, along with access to an outdoor terrace with fireplace perfect for entertaining. The second floor offers 4 bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with bath and fireplace as well as two additional bathrooms, laundry room and abundant closet space. A finished third floor with an additional bedroom and full bath along with a finished lower-level with full bath provides flexible living space with endless possibilities. Hardwood floors run throughout the home while a painted lower level offers a versatile recreational space ideal for hockey or roller skating. Large windows fill the home with natural light creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Meticulously maintained, the home has been consistently serviced by its original contractors. Pre-wired for audio and video. 480 SF in lower level is included in total square footage.
